mtlx check.summary: Run selected document checks on one or more .mtlx or .mtlx.zip files (glob patterns accepted)

flags.name: strict
flags.summary: Fail on warnings as well as errors

flags.name: rules
flags.summary: Rule groups to run (default: basic); renderer checks require a capability inventory

flags.name: format
flags.summary: Output format

mtlx info.summary: Print information about a .mtlx or .mtlx.zip file

flags.name: format
flags.summary: Output format

mtlx mcp.summary: Run a Model Context Protocol server over stdio (check, inspect, render, and edit tools for AI agents)

mtlx render.summary: Render a .mtlx or .mtlx.zip file to a PNG image using a local headless browser

flags.name: output
flags.summary: PNG file to write

flags.name: geometry
flags.summary: Preview geometry

flags.name: material
flags.summary: Material name (default: last material in the document)

flags.name: background
flags.summary: Backdrop behind the model; none keeps the IBL lighting but leaves the PNG transparent

flags.name: size
flags.summary: Image width and height in pixels

flags.name: browser
flags.summary: Chromium-based browser executable (default: installed Chrome, Edge, or Playwright Chromium)

flags.name: timeout
flags.summary: Seconds to wait for the material to compile

mtlx transform.summary: Convert, combine, or resize/reformat textures across one or more .mtlx / .mtlx.zip files (glob patterns accepted), writing --output. A directory --output batch-converts each input separately instead of combining.

flags.name: output
flags.summary: Output path; a .mtlx/.mtlx.zip path combines every input into one file, a directory converts each input separately (same basename, same format) into that directory

flags.name: verbose
flags.summary: Batch mode: print every file written instead of just a one-line summary

flags.name: dry-run
flags.summary: Transform and validate in memory, report planned files, and create no output

flags.name: profile
flags.summary: Apply a named texture preset (e.g. "web": webp-preferred, 2048px max, EXRs normalized to PIZ); only touches incompatible textures

flags.name: max-image-size
flags.summary: Resize any texture whose longest edge exceeds this many pixels; overrides --profile

flags.name: image-format
flags.summary: Comma-separated target formats (webp,png,jpg,avif,exr,hdr); overrides --profile. Each source converts to the target sharing its dynamic range: SDR sources use the first SDR target, HDR sources (exr/hdr) use the first HDR target. An HDR source with no HDR target requested is linearly clipped to SDR (no tone mapping). Append ":<compression>" to exr (e.g. "exr:piz") to normalize EXR compression; supported: none, rle, zips, zip, piz, pxr24, b44, b44a, dwaa, dwab

flags.name: image-quality
flags.summary: Quality for lossy image formats (webp/jpg/avif)

flags.name: texture-library
flags.summary: Loose .mtlx output only: copy textures into this directory (relative to --output) instead of ./textures. Ignored for .mtlx.zip output, whose resources remain inside the archive.

flags.name: format
flags.summary: Output format

mtlx view.summary: Open a local 3D preview of a .mtlx or .mtlx.zip file in your browser

mtlx docgen.summary: Write the OpenCLI document to a file, or stdout if --output is omitted

flags.name: output
flags.summary: Output file; defaults to stdout

flags.name: format
flags.summary: Output format
